$comment: Pins of the OPEN engine toolchain (Prompt 34 feasibility trial, docs/research/OPEN_WEB_IMAGE_BUILD_2026-10-09.md). Used only by scripts/open-toolchain/*. The standard build keeps engine/toolchain.lock.json (Oracle GraalVM). This file lives outside engine/ on purpose: every non-Markdown file under engine/ is part of the engine source identity, so a pin there would invalidate engine/engine.lock.json.

jdk.distribution: labsjdk-ce (OpenJDK with JVMCI, built by the GraalVM project)
jdk.licenseEvidence: legal/*/LICENSE in the archive: 69 identical files, SHA-256 4b9abebc4338048a7c2dc184e9f800deb349366bdf28eb23c2677a77b4c87726 (GPLv2 text with the Classpath exception); no file names the Oracle No-Fee Terms (NFTC) or the GraalVM Free Terms (GFTC)

reused.$comment: Same archives, versions and checksums as engine/toolchain.lock.json, so old and new builds differ only in GraalVM/JDK. web-image/README.md asks for wasm-as 119; 123 is kept so that both builds use the same assembler (binaryen output is the module itself, Apache-2.0).
